mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 55 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park. While the ISS will pass overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city is hosting a public information meeting on December 8th at the Senior Center to discuss the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, including bridge replacements and trail closures. Additionally, please remember to keep your recycling and refuse carts at least four feet apart and away from obstructions for easier collection.
There are currently no events scheduled on the community calendar for the next 30 days, but we will keep you updated if that changes.

In a report from November 8th, a driver was arrested for O W I after a single-vehicle crash occurred in the 600 block of South Main Street, resulting in the vehicle striking a light pole and catching fire.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy a scoop of Caramel Turtle at Culver's. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
